mesh_isotropic_remesh — 3D resolution op

• Data kinds: mesh → mesh

• Call: import meshres; meshres.mesh_isotropic_remesh(V, F, target_edge, iterations=5, project=True, relax=0.5) (or ops3d.get("mesh_isotropic_remesh"))

Usage

Incremental isotropic remeshing to a uniform *target_edge* (`mesh`).
